asset.name: TRENCH horizontal thumbwheel roller
must_not_modify: Do not redraw the well or frame.
Do not create a mockup-only replacement.

raw_strip.frame_128: byte-identical to frame 0 and no glow

runtime_strip.frame_128: byte-identical to frame 0 and no glow

runtime_rendering.source: crop one frame from the runtime strip
runtime_rendering.destination: inside the existing black well from df2_panel_shadow.png
runtime_rendering.panel: draw panel image first, then draw thumbwheel strip frame into the existing well

visual_goal.short_description: A tactile horizontal spinning thumbwheel embedded in a dark mechanical aperture.
read_order: dark smoked rubber or graphite wheel body
internal cyan emitter visible through broken apertures
visual_goal.fit_requirement: The roller must feel physically installed in the plugin panel, not pasted over it. Leave the existing well visible as the surrounding aperture and shadow.

geometry_model.motion_illusion: phase-shift the rib/window pattern horizontally under fixed lighting

body_shape.end_behavior: dark rounded rolloff and alpha falloff at left/right ends, but not a drawn capsule outline
body_shape.top_bottom_behavior: subtle alpha and luma falloff so the existing black aperture frames the body

rib_window_pattern.scale: coarse enough to read at plugin size; avoid fine comb teeth
rib_window_pattern.pattern: irregular vertical occluders and windows phase-shift horizontally
rib_window_pattern.role: occludes both shadow and cyan emitter

shadow_logic.rule: shadow must be broken by the rib/window mask; do not draw a continuous horizontal black stripe through the roller
shadow_logic.darkest_region: jagged recessed aperture pockets and occluder gaps
shadow_logic.must_avoid: one full-width black band across the center

fixed_material_light.description: Panel-compatible grey/white directional light on the wheel surface.
fixed_material_light.motion: fixed relative to the well, not scrolling with the cyan emitter
preferred_zones: broad broken highlight island along upper-left/top surface
small hard highlights on selected top ridges
lower/mid grey reflection patches behind the mask
fixed_material_light.color: grey, graphite, smoked metal, dirty white

cyan_emitter.description: Internal moving light behind the mask, visible only through apertures.
cyan_emitter.shape: short hot bead cluster plus uneven trailing cells
cyan_emitter.placement: slightly lower/recessed than the top highlight, behind the black mechanical mask
cyan_emitter.compositing_rule: cyan should lift and color existing dark window pixels, with rib occlusion preserved; it should not appear as a pasted blob or separate overlay

do_not_interpret_emu_as: cyan drawn on top of a wheel
a chain of repeating mechanical links

renderer_priority: Author at runtime displayed size first.
Generate raw 85x11 strip from the same geometry or parallel renderer.
Use one strip frame as the source of truth; do not add JUCE glow.

recommended_algorithm.base: dark smoked roller body with alpha/end falloff
recommended_algorithm.surface: coarse procedural rib/window field, phase shifted by frame
recommended_algorithm.highlight: fixed broad grey islands independent of frame phase
recommended_algorithm.emitter: moving cyan field multiplied by rib/window aperture mask
recommended_algorithm.final_fit: draw inset inside the panel well so df2_panel_shadow.png supplies the surrounding aperture

preview_checks: View a single frame composited into df2_panel_shadow.png at plugin size.
Check frame 64 has a readable short cyan cluster, not a dot and not a stripe.
Check the body reads as a tactile horizontal thumbwheel from normal plugin viewing distance.
Check the existing black well remains visible around the roller.

machine_checks: raw frame 0 bytes equal raw frame 128 bytes
runtime frame 0 bytes equal runtime frame 128 bytes
PluginEditor.cpp does not draw an extra cyan glow overlay
visual_checks: Fits inside existing well without redrawing panel/well/frame
Reads as horizontal tactile wheel, not vertical drum/cylinder/chain link
No continuous horizontal black line through center
Cyan appears internal and masked by wheel structure
Surface light is grey/material light and separate from cyan
